definition: The Parents & Kids Safe AI Coalition is a political action committee that advocates for regulation of artificial intelligence on child safety.
details: As of April 2026, the group is funded solely by the artificial intelligence company OpenAI, which pledged $10 million to the effort.
story: Picture a parachute packed by a second pair of hands: nobody plans to need it, but everyone is glad it was checked. The idea is simple: before something powerful is let loose, someone checks that it will not do real harm to real people. It is the habit of asking, before every launch, what could go wrong — and then doing something about it. Caution is not the enemy of progress — it is the reason progress gets to keep going. That deliberate caution is Parents & Kids Safe AI Coalition.
